title: chat test fails: duplicate-direct race phantom id ordering
description: chat_set_duplicate_direct_cleanup_destroy_failure_redacts_backend_display (crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/integration.rs:2317) fails deterministically at HEAD 9e113188 (verified in a clean worktree, 2026-10-19): notCreated is null and c0 is created. The queued race phantom has id "aaaa" while generated ids are time-derived hex (e.g. 18e012767b9c53b8); the duplicate-direct tie-break likely depends on id ordering, so the test depends on the wall clock. Found while implementing JMAP-x2gd.46.1.
close_reason: Fixed by 2a8bf0aa: race-cleanup test phantom id now '0', which sorts before every uuid v4; deterministic under all features. CI green at 8e240e18 (stable+beta 3502 passed).
